fields.subject: Re: Invoice 1180
fields.body: Following our call, invoice 1180 (PO-88102, £640.00 due 20 November 2026) is on hold while we check the delivery count with your warehouse team.

disputed.quote: is on hold while we check the delivery count

fields.subject: Invoice 7702 overdue
fields.body: Our invoice 7702 (PO-87990) for £980.00 was due on 1 October 2026 and remains unpaid.

note: A date whose year is not its quote's is cleared, so an overdue invoice cannot pass as next year's.

fields.subject: Invoice INV-9031 (EUR)
fields.body: Invoice INV-9031 for translation services. PO-88455. Amount due EUR 3,800.00 by 10 December 2026.

open_defect: an enum value is not checked against its quote: GBP read from 'EUR 3,800.00' gets through
